SW-LAB-01 # show
config system global
    set hostname "SW-LAB-01"
end
config system dns
    set primary 192.0.2.53
    set domain "exemplo.local"
end
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set ip 192.0.2.10 255.255.255.0
        set alias "Uplink-LAB-CORE"
        set description "Uplink-LAB-CORE"
    next
end
config system snmp sysinfo
    set contact-info "noc@exemplo.local"
    set location "Sala LAB"
end
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "COMM-TESTE"
    next
end
config user radius
    edit "RADIUS-LAB"
        set server "192.0.2.20"
        set secret CHAVE-TESTE-123
    next
end
SW-LAB-01 # get system arp
192.0.2.30     0a:1b:2c:3d:4e:60   port1
